label: Whatever is CREATURE_2 is CREATURE_1, from the Fourth-Way maximum (inference)
rule: Existential elimination on the maximum, reductio on its identity with the effect, then universal instantiation of its universal causation
meaning: Let c, distinct from x, cause x's being (x is CREATURE_2). The proved Fourth-Way consequence gives some m, maximal in being, that causes the being of every other being in act and whose being no being distinct from it causes. x is not m: otherwise c, distinct from m, would cause m's being. By the weak premise x is in act as to being, so m causes x's being. Hence x is CREATURE_1, with m as the universal cause it is ordered to. The CREATURE sense bridge is the conclusion (role conclusion); the premises use neither sense. Its weight sits in the Fourth-Way consequence, whose own premises (the four quarta via readings and the Metaphysics II.1 causal comparison) stay as they are: in particular the reading that the maximum causes the being of every other being in act, a thing caused by a secondary cause included. Conditional consequence; no premise is established. The controls show that the bridge fails without the Fourth-Way consequence (model 1) and without the weak premise (model 2).
